body.name: balanced polynomial-link observed-law class
body.construction: \(\mathcal P_K(a)=\{P:\eta/K\le p_X(x),p_W(w)\le1/(\eta K)\ \text{for all }(x,w)\in\mathcal X_K\times\mathcal W_K,\ c_{\rm link}\|L^{-a}g\|_{\ell^2_{K,W}}\le\|Ag\|_{L^2_X}\le C_{\rm link}\|L^{-a}g\|_{\ell^2_{K,W}}\ \text{for every mean-zero }g\in\ell^2_{K,W}\}\).
